sourceVersionNote: Repository sources reviewed in the shared B implementation checkout. Supplied base is task context, not a verified deployed revision; line anchors are source pointers and do not identify live resources.
purpose: Concrete B source catalog for reviewing runtime quiescence and cross-store target deletion coverage. This catalog is not a live target manifest, pause API, authorization grant or completed deletion proof.

contract.goal: Map every reviewed B writer/store to fixed workflow scope IDs, attribution limits, required pause/drain/verify evidence and source/live implementation boundaries.
invariants: Bind live execution/evidence to environment, project/database/tenant, verified target, request, purpose, proof and SAC generation; static counts cannot authorize execution.
SAC remains initially MyPage-only. Legacy Bot, !block and YouTube Ban semantics are preserved; legacy writers require separate pause/drain evidence.

Canon 05: no pre-cutoff queued/admitted work, captured snapshots, old token/mint/result, export/import/restore job or retry may restore old data after resume. Fresh legitimate post-resume use may create new data.

Preserve the complete inactive service-access-controls document and both reason states/generation/revision after privacy clear. No delete, TTL, subset tombstone or generation reset; restore/migration must preserve that checkpoint.
Preserve independent active moderation; an older request/generation cannot clear a newer privacy request or complete its receipt.
Unknown attribution/resources/permissions, overflow, failure, timeout or lost acknowledgement are unresolved evidence, never absent/zero/completed.
Current support receipt/proof dependencies are completed/cleaned by the separate completion stage after all runtime/store/resume postconditions. Other receipts are ownership-checked before cleanup.
No new retention/freshness duration, business rule or production authorization is established by this inventory.
nonGoals: No credentials, raw target IDs, user content, proof/challenge values or private operator contacts.
No changes to A authorization code or legacy Bot behavior.
acceptance: All fixed runtime/deletion scope IDs appear once.
Every writer has checked source anchors, launch/recreation routes and required evidence.
Every store distinguishes direct identity lookup from query/relationship/derived attribution.
Live gaps stay explicit and completion remains blocked until an authorized workflow obtains matching evidence.
verification: Local strict JSON parse, fixed ID uniqueness, writer/scope references and source anchor checks; no service tools invoked.
